create_sync_server: create a SyncServer instance with a global model and optional channel for federated learning aggregation
select_clients_sync_server: select clients for training using SyncServer select_clients_for_training with num_total_users and users_per_round
receive_update_sync_server: receive client model updates via SyncServer receive_update_from_client and aggregate weighted deltas
create_sync_sq_server: create a SyncSQServer with ScalarQuantizationChannel to handle scalar quantization of client updates
create_sync_pq_server: create a SyncPQServer with ProductQuantizationChannel to handle product quantization using seed centroids
